newsitem.title: USA: ATHLETICS-MICHAEL JOHNSON SAYS HE'LL RACE DONOVAN BAILEY IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MICHAEL JOHNSON SAYS HE'LL RACE DONOVAN BAILEY IN MAY.

text.p: Michael Johnson said Tuesday he will race Donovan Bailey for the "world's fastest human" title over 150 metres on May 31 in Toronto.

Johnson was interviewed in an Internet "chat session." Asked about the rumoured 150 metres race, he told ESPNET SportsZone: "We've scheduled something for May 31 in Toronto. More details will be coming later."

Johnson won gold medals at the Atlanta Olympics in both the 200 and 400 metres. He shattered the world record in the 200 metres with a mark of 19.32 seconds, eclipsing his own record of 19.66 set during the U.S. Olympic Trials.
Bailey, who won the 100 metres in a world-record time of 9.84 seconds, was unavailable for comment.
